oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: streaming p99 latency spike detected for websocket/sse cluster eu-west-1 at 7412345678. Affected route: /v1/generate/stream. SLO p99 breached.
oncall-bot: Pager: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345
eli: ack. I'm on call, pulling traces now.
maria: I'm seeing increased socket write latencies and proxy 502 timeouts. Can someone grep logs for "chunk_delay" and "slow_consumer"?
eli: found burst. sample:
```
2026-03-12T14:21:05Z socket=ws-78 chunk_delay=230ms client_id=svc-frontend-17 proxy_write=487ms
2026-03-12T14:21:06Z socket=ws-78 chunk_delay=1.2s client_id=svc-frontend-17 proxy_write=1203ms slow_consumer=true
```
ravi: tagging @ops-sre - looks like client-side backpressure + Nginx proxy keepalive pool exhaustion.
jamie: we had a deploy 3m before spike (deploy-bot: rolled out websocket-pool-tuning v2.1). Could be config regression.
deploy-bot: Rolling back websocket-pool-tuning v2.1 -> v2.0 initiated by eli.
eli: rolling back now, scaling websocket workers +20% and bumping proxy keepalive from 30s -> 75s.
ops-sre: mitigation steps applied: scaled ws-workers, increased keepalive, enabled client read-timeout circuit at 30s. Watching metrics.
maria: added temporary traffic-shaper rule to limit simultaneous streaming connections per IP to 50.
customer-success: heard back from customer A: intermittent stalls for ~30-90s windows, some sessions reconnected. Collecting customer ids.
eli: probe script run against /v1/generate/stream:
```
for i in $(seq 1 50); do curl -N -s https://inference.eu-west-1/v1/generate/stream -H "Authorization: Bearer x" & done
```
Observing p95 drop from 850ms -> 110ms after mitigations, p99 still at ~1.15s but trending down.
maria: root cause hypothesis: regression in pool tuning + sudden traffic pattern with many slow consumers holding sockets open -> proxy buffer exhaustion -> head-of-line stalls.
ravi: next actions: 1) keep rollback for 2h, 2) rebuild canary with backpressure-protection enabled, 3) postmortem if p99 doesn't return within SLA window, 4) notify impacted customers with timeline.
eli: I've opened incident ticket #INC-2026-314 in Jira and assigned to eng-runtime (eli, maria, ravi). Please add logs/traces.
ops-sre: monitoring: enabling alert cooldown to avoid duplicate paging while we stabilize.
customer-success: preparing templated outreach. Will wait for final impact list.
jamie: tagging follow-ups: add synthetic tests for slow-consumer scenarios, add alert for proxy_write > 1s with 5m window.
eli: oncall handoff note: I'll stay for next 30m; if p99 < 500ms for two consecutive 5m windows, I'll handoff to next oncall @ravi.
ravi: copy, will take over if needed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Incident state: mitigated->watching. Pager quieted at 7412345978.
